jobs.description:
If you are looking for a job where you can work part-time or full-time, we have the perfect option for you! Join us now as a production employee at Kuehne + Nagel in Zaandam. Working in a close team and a lot of varied work sounds good, doesn't it! And all that for a nice salary of € 14,99! Do you work in the weekend or evenings? Then there are also extra  allowances for the evening and night. Work hard, and you might get a permanent contract at Kuehne + Nagel after just 10 weeks!

We dot not provide housing. If you are EU-citizen and need accommodation you can apply here:
https://www.tempo-team.nl/vacatures?specialtype=euflex

Apply now and receive a WhatsApp message within 15 minutes with a few short questions, so that we can help you quickly. Don't have WhatsApp? Then we will contact you by phone or e-mail!

What we offer
- Nice salary of €14,99 gross per hour
- Allowances up till 100%
- Salary increase every year
- Travel expenses
- Chance for a permanent contract after 10 weeks!
- Part-time or full-time job. You choose!

Who you are
As a production employee, you are available at least 3 days a week. Besides that it is important that you meet the following requirements;

- You are 18 years or older
- You speak English or Dutch
- You can work at least 3 days during the week
- You can work in 3 shifts; 6:00-15:00 and 15:00-00:00 and 21:00 - 06:00
- You have your own accommodation in the area of Zaandam
- You are available to work for at least 2 months
- You have your own transporation

What will you do
Your day as production employee starts in the canteen, a chat with your colleagues and a game of table soccer to warm up for the working day! Your working day will be different every day, because you are all-round employable in the whole warehouse, so lots of variety! Kuehne + Nagel processes all returns coming back from the Albert Heijn. You can think of all packaging such as beer crates and plastic bottles. But also food that can no longer be sold in the stores.

READY TO TAKE YOUR WAREHOUSE SKILLS TO THE NEXT LEVEL?

Are you an experienced warehouse worker and confident operating warehouse equipment? Join DHL Supply Chain in Weert as an EPT, OPT, Reachtruck or Forklift Driver!

- Full-time availability – You are available for 40 hours per week. Shifts from 06:00 - 15:00 & 15:00 - 00:00, rotating weekly.
- Relevant experience – Experience with EPT, OPT, reachtruck or forklift work is preferred.
- Certificate – A valid certificate for the equipment you operate is a plus.
- Own transportation – You can independently travel to and from work.
- English skills – You can communicate in English at work.
- Safety-minded & reliable – You work carefully, take responsibility and follow safety instructions.
- Team player – You enjoy working together with colleagues to get the job done.

Ready to hit the ground running during the busy period starting November 16th? Come join the Sorting Team and work with the latest Nike products! Performing well? Then you can simply keep working after the peak season ends!

What we offer
- Earn €14.99 per hour
- Surcharges of up to 100% on Sundays!
- Travel expense allowance of €0.21 per km
- Fulltime work!
- 8.33% holiday allowance
- Modern warehouse with background music!

Who you are
As a logistics employee at Aramex, you are physically fit enough to work with Nike products. In addition, you are:

- You can apply for a Certificate of Conduct (VOG).
- You are available for three shifts (08:30 AM–5:00 PM / 11:00 AM–6:30 PM / 5:15 PM–10:00 PM).
- You are available to work flexibly between Monday and Sunday.
- You speak Dutch and/or English.

What will you do
Als cruciale schakel in het Sorter Team zorg jij voor de snelle verwerking van Nike-artikelen:

- Sorting tasks: Sort boxes and products directly from the sorting machine.
- Onboarding: You will start as soon as possible with training for at least 3 days a week (24 hours).
- Peak period: From November onwards, you will work 40 hours a week.

Where will you work
As soon as you step into the large warehouse, you get a clear overview of the space. There’s a pleasant, fresh atmosphere, and a radio plays in the background, creating a cheerful vibe. The hours fly by before you know it! It’s a modern company, and you’ll get to know plenty of great colleagues. Plus, as a logistics employee, you can work part-time with a flexible schedule. This allows you to work when it suits you and easily plan around your personal life. You can also earn extra pay by working weekends. On top of that, you’ll be working at bustling Schiphol, making it super easy to reach Aramex by public transport. Yes!

Job application
Can't wait to get started? Click "Apply" and we'll call you as soon as possible! Questions? Feel free to call, text, or email us.  Uiteraard staat deze vacature open

Do you want to get to work in the evening hours, so that you have time during the day for hobbies, studies, or your family? And do you like to be physically active while working? Then this is the job for you! As a warehouse worker you earn up to €15.85 gross per hour, your travel expenses are reimbursed, and you build up a pension for your old age. You also receive an ADV allowance of 1.38% and have opportunities for advancement. And to top it all off, you even have a chance of getting a permanent contract! Curious if you qualify? Read on and apply today!

For UPS in Apeldoorn, employment agency Manpower is looking for several warehouse employees who want to work the evening shift.

As a warehouse worker at UPS Apeldoorn, you always work in a team, which ensures a combination of hard work and a pleasant atmosphere. In this position, you work carefully, accurately, and with attention to targets, performing the following tasks:

    - Processing incoming goods and packages
    
- Sorting shipments by postal code
    
- Loading and unloading trucks according to the route (depending on the shift)
    
- Scanning and checking packages and documents

This position involves physically demanding work, such as a lot of walking, carrying, lifting packages, and performing repetitive tasks.

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €15.85 per hour, including 1.38% ADV allowance
    
- Long-term position on a temporary employment basis with the possibility of a permanent contract
    
- Part-time job of approximately 20 hours per week
    
- Travel allowance according to UPS's scheme
    
- Various opportunities for advancement to other positions
    
- On-the-job training when you start working
    
- Working in an international environment

    - Good command of the Dutch or English language, due to safety reasons
    
- Because of the working hours, you must be at least eighteen years old
    
- A Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) stating that you do not have a criminal record
    
- Physically able

Looking for an active job with good pay and attractive shift allowances? Join DHL as a Logistics Employee and work together with your colleagues to ensure parcels reach their destinations on time!

What will you do?

You will help ensure the sorting process runs smoothly. Your tasks include placing parcels on the conveyor belt, handling sorted shipments, and supporting the team with daily operations. Parcels can weigh up to 25 kg. Heavier or difficult-to-lift parcels are always handled together with a colleague. You will work Monday to Friday, 3 to 5 days per week. Shifts generally start around 5:00 PM and end around 2:45 AM. Exact start and finish times may vary.

- You are available at least 3 to 4 days per week.
- You are at least 18 years old.
- You speak Dutch or English.
- You live in or near Zwolle, Meppel, or Kampen.
- You have your own transportation or live within walking distance of the sorting center.

Does seeing happy faces give you a boost of energy? Are you looking for a full-time or part-time catering job that genuinely fits your lifestyle? Look no further! We have a great opportunity for you as a Catering Assistant at ASML in Eindhoven!

What we offer
- €14.99  per hour
- Holiday pay and pension accrual
- On-call basis  so you decide when you work!
- Travel allowance
- Great work environment and plenty of variety
- Want to learn more? training courses!

Who you are
You understand that hospitality is all about the details, and you find fulfillment in taking care of others. As a Catering Assistant, it is also important that you:

- Are reliable and outgoing;
- Speak fluent Dutch and/or English;
- Are available during the week from Monday through Friday between 7:30 AM and 4:00 PM.

What will you do
Your mission? Delight guests with delicious food and a flawlessly presented setting! As a Catering Assistant, you are the unsung hero of lunches, after-work drinks, and events. You ensure everything is ready and looks fantastic from start to finish.

- Preparing, presenting, and restocking all food and beverages.
- Welcoming guests and running cash register shifts.
- Delivering an excellent customer experience and keeping tables and the work area clean and tidy.
- Assisting with dishwashing and other cleaning duties.

Where will you work
You'll be working through Tempo-Team. That means you are never just a number; we are your partner in job satisfaction. We believe that when you feel good, your guests notice right away. That’s why flexibility and your preferences always come first with us. As a Catering Assistant at ASML, you can work across multiple locations on site. You'll often work alongside fellow Tempo-Team colleagues. You’ll always be learning something new and will always have a great team around you!

- Set your own schedule and stay in control of your work-life balance.
- Discover variety and growth opportunities across multiple locations in the Eindhov

- Lifting boxes up to 10 kg is no problem for you.

Are you looking for a flexible job that fits perfectly into your life? Become an Uber Eats delivery courier!
Decide when you work, cycle through the city, and earn money while doing it. With Uber Eats, you enjoy the freedom to work on your own terms. 
What are you going to do?
As a courier for Uber Eats, you’ll be the link between restaurants and hungry customers.

Your main tasks include:

- Picking up meals from local restaurants
- Navigating the fastest route using the Uber Eats app
- Delivering with a smile – keeping customers happy and well-fed

What do we offer?
- Salary: Starting at €16,19 gross/hour (age 21+), including holiday pay
- Peak earnings: Up to € 19,49 gross/hour with daily bonuses and and keep 100% of your tips
- Gear: We provide the necessary gear to keep you safe and comfortable during delivery – delivery bag, helmet and phone holder
- Benefits: 20 paid vacation days + pension contributions from day one
- Flexible schedule: Plan all of your work, yourself through your phone beforehand. We do not set your work schedule

Where will you work?
Join Uber Eats and become part of a global leader in food delivery that offers flexible work opportunities, competitive earnings, and the freedom to choose your own schedule. Whether you're looking for full-time or part-time work, Uber Eats provides a simple way to earn while delivering food and connecting communities, and flexibility. Our shared goal is for all our deliveries to be emission-free by 2040. 
What do we ask?
To start as a delivery courier with Uber Eats, you must meet the following conditions:
•            You are at least 16 years old
•            You live in the Netherlands
•            You speak either Dutch or English
•            You have a smartphone with an internet connection
•            You have your own bicycle, e-bike, or scooter

Please note: delivery using a car, e-step (electric scooter), or any other vehicle is not allowed
